question: When does the committee hear the transit hub variances, and can I speak?
note: The eval runner saved only the final answer, so no steps are shown. Statement kinds weren't saved and are shown as "fact"; every citation was checked again by code when this file was made. The start time is worked out from the report's end time and each case's duration.

event.text: The Committee of Adjustment hears the transit hub minor variance application on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. [1] Yes, you can speak at the public meeting. [2] You may also submit written comments for the committee to consider. [2]

statements.text: The Committee of Adjustment hears the minor variance application on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, at 10:00 a.m.

citations.quote: Committee of Adjustment for the City of Kitchener will meet in Council Chambers, 2nd Floor, Kitchener City Hall, 200 King Street West, on TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 17, 2026, commencing at 10:00 a.m.

statements.text: Anyone interested may speak at the public meeting or submit comments in writing for the committee to consider.

citations.quote: Anyone who has an interest in any of these applications may make oral submission at the meeting or provide a written submission for Committee consideration.
